text:
Jared (Support): FYI LumenPay trial blocked — SSO redirect returns intermittent 502 during auth, users can't finish onboarding. Renewal touch in 30 days, seat commit at risk. Passing to CS for priority handling.

Priya (CSM): Thanks Jared. How many users affected and any reproducible steps?

Jared (Support): ~12 unique users over the last 2 hours, ~80% on mobile. No config changes from our side. Quick log excerpt: ```auth-service 2025-03-18T09:12:33Z ERROR upstream response status=502 tx=0.23s x-request-id=abc123```

Amir (CS Lead): Marking this as high renewal risk. Priya, run the SSO sync cookbook steps and prepare a concise customer comms. I'll coordinate the internal comms and follow-up.

Priya (CSM): On it. I need SE help to check token refresh and IdP metadata — @Lauren (SE) can you join?

Lauren (SE): I'm on it. Will check IdP certs, metadata and token TTL. Also linking our quickcheck runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sso-quickcheck

ops_bot: Incident created: INC-20250318-1743 (assigned to eng-infra).

Amir (CS Lead): Priya, draft a short external message: acknowledge + ETA + mitigation + next steps. Keep it <3 sentences. I'll review before send.

Priya (CSM): Draft: "We detect intermittent SSO auth failures for some users. We're working with engineering on a fix; temporary workaround is to use desktop login or clear the app cache. ETA ~2 hours — we'll update you. —Priya" @Jared OK to send?

Jared (Support): Go ahead. Add: "If you need immediate access, create an additional org admin via the support portal."

Lauren (SE): Found that the customer's IdP cert rotated yesterday and token TTL is 2h while our auth metadata cache is 10m — likely a short window mismatch causing failed handshakes. Plan: 1) validate IdP cert chain 2) force-refresh metadata 3) temporarily reduce cache TTL to 1m. Posting details to INC-20250318-1743.

Amir (CS Lead): Owners: Lauren -> SE investigation & eng ticket, Priya -> customer comms and daily follow-ups, Jared -> monitoring and escalate to eng-oncall if spike. I'll set a 10:30 sync invite.

Priya (CSM): Comms sent to customer at 09:45 — they acknowledged and accepted the temp workaround. I'll run an activation sweep and log affected users in the case.

Jared (Support): After metadata refresh error rate is dropping, seeing fewer 502s in logs. Will watch for 30 more minutes. :thumbsup:

Amir (CS Lead): Good. If errors reappear mark renewal flag 'at-risk' and escalate to account exec. Also record the mitigation steps and timeline in the renewal notes.

Priya (CSM): Notes for ticket: comms sent, workaround provided, SE refreshed metadata, eng-infra incident opened. Follow-up sync tomorrow 09:00 to confirm stability. Closing triage thread here unless regression.

Jared (Support): Thanks team — standing by for any regression alerts.
